attempts.verifier_evidence: block B010f: ok=true under temporary theorem name successor_is_injective_compact
attempts.diagnosis: One representation bridge and one cancellation chain are the shortest verified proof spine.
attempts.next_change: Materialize this compact body under the public theorem name successor_is_injective.

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm successor_is_injective:
    ? forall:
        $injective(N, N, successor)
    claim:
        ? forall x, y N:
            successor(x) = successor(y)
            =>:
                x = y
        x + 1 = successor(x) = successor(y) = y + 1
        x = x + 1 - 1 = y + 1 - 1 = y
    by def $injective(N, N, successor)
blocks.reusable_lesson: For successor injectivity, preserve the native predicate and expose only the application-to-addition bridge plus explicit natural-number cancellation.
